scope: Independent review of the retained default image scan, installed package metadata and Debian primary-source snapshots
acceptance_contract: A20 requires compatible updates, complete qualification and precise reachability rationale plus expiry for residual exceptions. Universal zero-HIGH is not its original clause; this review accepts no exception.
limitations: No immediate Debian security advisory does not establish fixed or safe code.
An unstable/testing fix does not establish a supported Trixie upgrade.
Missing homed and Archive::Tar paths narrow component presence without overriding affected source-package status.
The original package-metadata parser error and its corrected result remain retained; no image measurement was replayed.
